interpretation: 2020–2024 ACS five-year resident population estimates for the included reporting areas. Includes children and nonvoters; not votes, voters, or a 2024-only population count.
scope: 3,103 comparable counties and county equivalents across 48 states. Connecticut is excluded because reporting areas changed. Alaska has statewide totals only. DC is excluded. Existing source combinations of Bedford city/county and Kansas City/Jackson are retained.

source_files.scope: Complete county section in official table prefix; incomplete trailing row ignored
